quinoa actually better.reply: A little, for most people. Quinoa has more protein, fibre and minerals than white rice and a gentler effect on blood sugar, which helps it keep you full. White rice is still a fine, easy-to-digest base, and the brown rice in most of your week already closes much of the gap. If you'd like to try quinoa, I could put the Garlic Shrimp & Quinoa with Spinach in for one of your rice dinners. Want that?
